## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Relevant Android tests/lint/build (when packaged behavior changes)
- [ ] Mobile interaction/visual checks (when UI or motion changes)
- [ ] Persistence/import/resume checks (when data changes)

## Approval and release

- [ ] Candidate is ready for user acceptance.
- [ ] Durable docs and `[Unreleased]` are updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated builds, or unrelated changes are included.

Do not tag, publish, archive an APK, or install on a phone from this pull request unless the user separately authorizes release/publication.
